analysis.why_it_works: This ad cleverly hijacks the massive cultural awareness of Ozempic while promising similar digestive benefits without the prescription drug. It uses humor and familiarity to lower resistance - the playful 'New Bestie' creates a friendly, approachable tone. The bear-shaped gummy format makes health supplementation feel fun rather than clinical. By specifically addressing bloating and constipation - two uncomfortable but common issues people are embarrassed to discuss - it taps into a high-intent audience actively seeking relief.
analysis.visual_elements: Large green serif font headline, smaller black sans-serif subheadline, green gummy bear product shot, green product package with yellow bear face logo, 'SUGAR-FREE' badge on package, beige/cream background, poop emoji in the bottom copy, minimalist layout with generous white space
analysis.composition: Centered vertical layout with headline at top, subheadline below, product imagery in middle (gummy bear and package arranged diagonally), bottom text with emoji. Approximately 4:5 aspect ratio portrait orientation.
analysis.angle: Humor/relatability combined with mechanism education. The ad uses the cultural phenomenon angle by referencing Ozempic, making it instantly recognizable and relevant.
analysis.audience: Adults 25-45, likely skewing female, who are aware of Ozempic's popularity but may not have access or want prescription medication. Health-conscious individuals dealing with digestive discomfort who prefer natural solutions. Solution-aware audience actively seeking digestive relief products.

adaptation.adaptation_strategy: This adaptation preserves the exact composition, layout, and visual hierarchy of the Grüns ad - centered vertical layout with large serif headline, subheadline, diagonal product arrangement, and bottom tagline. The key changes are: replacing the Ozempic cultural reference with a juicing insight angle, swapping the green gummy bear and package for Motilli's celery juice gummies and single-serve pack, and adapting the digestive health messaging to focus on fiber restoration for GLP-1 users.

Replace the large green gummy bear with a light green celery-shaped gummy in the exact same position (left of center). Replace the green package with a Motilli single-serve pack positioned at the same diagonal angle behind the gummy - the pack should be white with subtle green celery stalk illustrations and minimalist design.
